name: gms-remote-test
description: Operate the GMS Remote Test platform through the bundled gms-rt CLI: device inventory, CTS/GTS/VTS/STS execution, durable job status, reports, firmware burn, USB/IP, VPN. Self-contained; requires GMS_REMOTE_TEST_SERVER (and credentials via stdin). Adds read-only device shell (gms_rt_shell) for agent diagnostics, admin step-up elevation (gms_rt_auth_elevate) and typed firmware burn (gms_rt_burn_firmware); jobs output is rendered one line per job.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the GMS Remote Test Controller: devices, tests, jobs, reports, firmware

requiresEnv.name: GMS_REMOTE_TEST_SERVER
requiresEnv.description: Base URL of the GMS Remote Test Controller, e.g. https://CONTROLLER:5001

requiresEnv.name: GMS_CURL_CA_CERT
requiresEnv.description: Path to a trusted CA bundle for the Controller's TLS certificate; set GMS_CURL_INSECURE=1 only for controlled self-signed deployments
